profile.headline: Senior SWE @Apple
profile.summary:
Software Engineer. Entrepreneur. Event Stylist. Blogger.  
Visit my tech journal at: https://swiftnerd.com/

I’m a Bay Area girl, a Software Engineer by day, an event stylist by night, an entrepreneur at heart and a hobbyist travel blogger.  I’m a thrill seeker and a major history buff.

My career objective is to make everyday life easier with technologies. I am currently working on IoT software platform focusing on connecting everything to the internet through great applications via mobile and web.


Languages:
Swift 3, Javascript ES6 (Vue.js, Node.js, JQuery, D3), Web Technologies (SCSS, Bootstrap, HTML5, JSON, WebRTC, WebSocket)

Tools and IDE:
Xcode, WebStorm, Github, Jira, Confluence, Sketch, Photoshop

Platform:
iOS [9.x and above]

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently building User Interface for AirPlay enabled TVs and bringing awesome streaming experiences to all platforms.

positions.title: Owner/Designer
positions.description: Manage a successful and profitable design company specializing in custom invitations and flo­rals for weddings, non-profits and special events. Design and maintain company’s website and blog.  Conduct market research to drive brand awareness to FlowerandPaper.com

positions.title: Senior iOS Engineer
positions.description:
Present:
Currently working on Cisco IoT Software Platform:
 - Designing mobile and web applications that focus on bringing smart things into the network, secure them, enable them, analyze them.  More to come soon...

Latest Shipped Product:
VSM Viewer iOS app is the main mobile client for Cisco Video Surveillance Management System. VSM Viewer allows user to gain access to their surveillance cameras and remotely monitor live and recorded streams wherever you are.  

 - Primary iOS engineer for IoT App
 - Significant involvement with UX, design, and product decisions.
 - Worked on the following features:
    * FFmpeg player to play Live and Recorded RTSP streams.
    * Bridged Javascript hosted map to native Objective-C 
    * API, network and data infrastructure
    * Video Timeline
    * PTZ Presets
    * User interface workflow and storyboards
    

VSOM - Video Surveillance Operation Manager (Web App)
* Collaborate with product marketing and cross-functional teams to drive the the development of the overall technical design and architecture of UI work flows, user-interactions, visual designs and software development.

* Coordinate with QA and leads to ensure successful roll out of new features.

* Collaborate with designers and content creators to brainstorm solutions that satisfy design and content requirements.

* Design, author and maintain highly extensible ExtJS class libraries and widgets that are shared and used throughout different components of the Video Surveillance Product.

* Incorporate configurations and management of IP/Analog Cameras, Encoders, and Media Servers via web applications.

* Design UI and interactions for PTZ and Motion-Enabled cameras to be controlled via web application.

* Work with ActiveX client and streaming videos.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintains Cisco SCM infrastructure for over 10,000 engineers on a rotating 24x7 basis.  Lead the development and release of SCM tools, providing easy wrappers over ClearCase commands.  Develop project plan, defines schedules, deliverables, resources and budget for medium scale software tooling projects.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer, internship
positions.description: Designed enterprise content management systems and web reporting systems, targeting Cisco’s strategic cus­tomers, for executives, business partners, operation ana lysts and customer support engineers.

positions.title: Application Developer, internship
positions.description: Designed customer facing web applications focusing on dynamic content retrieval, session management, cross-browser compatibility and performance optimization.
